svg.title: Self-maintaining drone swarm
svg.desc: Animated top-down view of six simulated Crazyflie drones flying in a room swept by four Lighthouse base stations, taking turns to land on chargers. Positions come from the project's own simulator.
svg.text: A Lighthouse-tracked Crazyflie swarm designed to plan
around weak tracking coverage, land to recharge and
repair itself; so far tested in simulation and Gazebo
with the real firmware, ahead of hardware flights.
real trajectories from the project simulator · 20 sim-min in 12 s
